write_semantics.healthy_row_guard: Hold publication at final WS_DONE for7 edges after final32nd source-observed ack; CLK_PS1000 binding mandatory; all32 writes acknowledged

write_semantics.read_turnaround: Existing same-PC RD-turnaround can protect a subsequent read but is not a write-drain or reset acknowledgement
write_semantics.source_fault_extra_gap: Original m_v WC/WS/FR branch lacks !fault; FR_PIPE issue is fault-gated. An accepted block may still have latent follow-up WS intent. WINDOW freeze ack must cover source write intents, not only currently accepted backend writes.
